title: Charlie Rose   Eric Schmidt
summary: A short Charlie Rose interview clip of Eric Schmidt discussing Google's direction for search. It is remembered for his remark that returning more than one result is a bug.
why: Quoted, often critically, to argue that Google aims for a single answer and to compare it with ChatGPT-style answers.

quote.text: Here's an old video where Eric Schmidt mentions Google's goal of being like ChatGPT
